name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Could an American win men's singles at this year's U.S. Open?
changes.summary: The Athletic's Lukas Weese joins CBS News to discuss who has the best chances with the U.S. Open tennis tournament underway in New York City.

changes.title: Venezuela grants U.S.-backed oil firm NABEP 100-year concessions for 17 oil fields, White House says
changes.summary: Venezuelan interim authorities have granted North American Blue Energy Partners 100-year concessions for 17 oil fields, White House says.

changes.title: Daily fragment: TWA Flight 529
changes.summary: TWA Flight 529 crashed shortly after takeoff from Midway Airport in Chicago, killing all 78 people on board. At the time, it was the deadliest single plane disaster in U.S. history.

changes.title: Army Secretary Daniel Driscoll Resigns as U.S. Military Grapples With Two Wars
changes.summary: The resignation of Daniel P. Driscoll, the secretary of the Army, had been expected but comes at a tumultuous time for the service.

changes.title: How the Pentagon Is Getting Into the Venezuelan Oil Business Under Trump
changes.summary: The Defense Department’s Office of Strategic Capital, founded by the Biden administration to give loans to bolster the U.S. defense industry, is helping lead President Trump’s oil deal.

changes.title: Army Secretary Dan Driscoll submits resignation to White House
changes.summary: Army Secretary Dan Driscoll is expected to step down in the coming days after the White House accepted his resignation, according to three U.S. officials. Driscoll has served in the role since February 2025 and has been a close associate of Vice President JD Vance. NBC News' Gordon Lubold reports.

changes.title: Whatever happened to the U.S. famine alert system that Trump shut down, then reopened
changes.summary: The highly regarded FEWS NET network stopped posting data on Afghanistan, Somalia and Yemen -- then says it will start posting again in September. What's the reason for this back-and-forth? (Image credit: Sally Hayden/SOPA Images/LightRocket).

changes.title: Lionel Messi says he's retiring from playing internationally for Argentina
changes.summary: The soccer star is ending 21 years of Argentine national-team duty but will continue to play at club level with Inter Miami in U.S. Major League Soccer. (Image credit: Sergei Grits).

changes.title: Analyst breaks down challenges U.S. will face to unlock Venezuela's oil
changes.summary: President Trump announced an unprecedented agreement in which the Pentagon would become an investor in a private company granted exclusive oil development rights in Venezuela. Nick Schifrin discussed the deal with Francisco Monaldi, director of the Latin America Energy Program for the Baker Institute at Rice University.

changes.title: U.S. Strikes May Have Targeted a New Type of Iranian Naval Mine
changes.summary: The U.S. military said its attacks against Iran were in response to a threat to the Strait of Hormuz.
